analysis:
The PR changes CI caching only. It touches .github/actions/provider-ci-build/action.yml and .github/workflows/ci.yml and does not touch provider runtime code, coordinator protocol, keys or attestation. I found no concrete regression against the provider threat model (T-034, T-013, T-054 and others), and nothing here touches the A-001 through A-018 assets.

Changes examined:
- SAVE_CACHES (ci.yml:17-19) is true only for push events on refs/heads/master or refs/heads/dev. The composite action takes a save-caches input (action.yml:7-9), and every cache/save step (action.yml:107, 116, 143; ci.yml mimo-audio, cluster and .git saves) is gated on it. Compared with base, this removes pull-request cache writes. Base let a PR save when nothing matched (base action.yml:91, ci.yml:747-755), so the change narrows the cache-poisoning surface. Pull requests only restore entries from their base or default branch.
- New .git cache restore, fsck check and save steps appear in every checkout. They use persist-credentials: false, and the save runs after checkout, so the job token is not stored in the saved .git/config. The Docs Lint job (ci.yml:164-198) uses a separate git-full-v1 key family.
- Sparse checkout excludes the evidence tarballs and landing media for every job except Docs Lint.
- SwiftPM repository cache (action.yml:47-53, 115-120): its keys are bound to Package.resolved and the home layout.
- The cluster build key drops `git describe` text (ci.yml:923).

Remaining questions for the next pass:
(1) git rev-parse and git fsck --connectivity-only run on a restored .git before it is validated. They do not verify object hashes, hooks or config such as core.fsmonitor. The cache's integrity therefore rests entirely on the push-only, ref-scoped save policy. I saw no PR-writable path to it. The Linux release-integrity job can run on a Darkbloom Sandbox or Blacksmith runner, both under key git-v1-Linux-. Whether the sandbox runner is trusted is not shown in the diff.
(2) MiMo audio gate steps (ci.yml:401-415) now depend on needs.changes.outputs.mimo_audio == 'true'. component-changes.yml and scripts/ci-component-paths.py are not in the supplied diff, so I could not confirm that the output exists or that master pushes set it. If it is missing, the audio gate silently skips. That is a CI coverage reduction, not a vulnerability proven here.
